parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT row_to_json(c) FROM conversas c WHERE c.telefone = $1) AS conversa,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(s ORDER BY s.id), '[]') FROM servicos s WHERE s.ativo) AS servicos,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(to_char(a.inicio, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI')), '[]')
     FROM agendamentos a
    WHERE a.status = 'confirmado'
      AND a.inicio >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Boa_Vista')::date
      AND a.inicio <  (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Boa_Vista')::date + 31) AS ocupados,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', a.id, 'inicio', to_char(a.inicio, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), 'servico_id', a.servico_id) ORDER BY a.inicio), '[]')
     FROM agendamentos a
    WHERE a.telefone = $1 AND a.status = 'confirmado'
      AND a.inicio >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Boa_Vista')) AS meus;

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
conv AS (
  INSERT INTO conversas (telefone, idioma, etapa, dados, atualizado_em)
  SELECT j->>'telefone', j->'conversa'->>'idioma', j->'conversa'->>'etapa', coalesce(j->'conversa'->'dados', '{}'::jsonb), now() FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (telefone) DO UPDATE
    SET idioma = EXCLUDED.idioma, etapa = EXCLUDED.etapa, dados = EXCLUDED.dados, atualizado_em = now()
  RETURNING telefone
),
novo AS (
  INSERT INTO agendamentos (telefone, nome, servico_id, inicio, idioma)
  SELECT j->>'telefone', j->'acao'->>'nome', (j->'acao'->>'servico_id')::int, (j->'acao'->>'inicio')::timestamp, coalesce(j->'conversa'->>'idioma', 'pt')
    FROM p WHERE j->'acao'->>'tipo' = 'agendar'
  ON CONFLICT (inicio) WHERE status = 'confirmado' DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
cancelado AS (
  UPDATE agendamentos a SET status = 'cancelado'
    FROM p
   WHERE p.j->'acao'->>'tipo' = 'cancelar'
     AND a.id = (p.j->'acao'->>'id')::int
     AND a.telefone = p.j->>'telefone'
  RETURNING a.id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM conv) AS conversa_salva,
       (SELECT id FROM novo) AS agendamento_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM cancelado) AS cancelados;
